content: The closing passage dismisses those who derive a person's Ascendant sign from his name without knowing the principles of ʿilm-i ḥarf, saying they merely approximate from experience (tajriba). MK's footnote points to Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī's manual on extracting information from personal names and honorifics, published as Sifr-i Jafr (Tehran 2007).
